verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a commerce and payments platform could plausibly offer event-triggered automation rules. However, the pack documents no rule engine or user-definable trigger-to-action configuration. PayPal webhooks only send event notifications to a merchant server, which leaves the developer to build any automated response, so they count as a building block rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
